translations.web: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
translations.bsb: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
translations.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
translations.asv: And if indeed they had been mindful of that country from which they went out, they would have had opportunity to return.
